p70CapabilityFinding.mechanism: the root returned 31 DISTINCT 2xx HTML documents and the landed regex extractor reduced every one of them to zero characters of main text. With no text at all, the near-duplicate pass cannot separate the pages, so every page is short-text-unresolved
p70CapabilityFinding.isThisTheSameQuestionAsP59: RELATED BUT NOT IDENTICAL. Both are short-text SD7 ambiguities, but P:59's range is [1, 24] over pages that DID carry text, and P:70's is [0, 31] over pages that carried NONE. The second points at extraction rather than at near-duplicate tuning
p70CapabilityFinding.isThisAnExtractionDEFECT: UNKNOWN on this evidence, and deliberately left unknown. Zero extracted text is consistent with a client-rendered site, with markup this extractor legitimately declines to read as content, and with a genuine defect. Distinguishing them requires semantic inspection of a FINAL_HOLDOUT item, which is forbidden, or a separate authorised capability review
p70CapabilityFinding.whyNotRepairedNow: this task's authority ends at this window's adjudication, no extraction repair is authorised, and a repair chosen from one holdout item would be fitted to it

r6628Finding.mechanism: the policy request answered 302 to the SAME canonical path on a DIFFERENT REGISTRABLE DOMAIN
r6628Finding.why: the path was already canonical on both sides. The trailing-slash capability was never engaged and would not have applied
r6628Finding.isThisANewCapabilityGap: NO. It is a reviewed, deliberate boundary - the one place this repository is stricter than RFC 9309 s2.3.1.2's 'even across authorities' - and it behaved exactly as ADR 0013 s3 specifies
r6628Finding.wideningRecommended: not on one observation. It would be its own owner decision, its own ADR and its own policy version, and it raises a policy-authority question ADR 0013 s6 examined at length
r6628Finding.slot66HasNowFailedOnThreeDistinctOccupan: its original selection, reserve 27 under v6, reserve 27 under v7, and now reserve 28 - four runs across three occupants, each for a different mechanical reason. That is recorded plainly and is not, by itself, evidence of a systemic defect

p5Adjudication.doesThisVindicateTheP5ReviewsConclusion: it is CONSISTENT with it and proves nothing on its own. The review concluded the recurring pauses reflected a heterogeneous base rate of unusable roots rather than one defect; a single clean window is one more draw from that same base rate, not a demonstration that the instrument is correctly tuned
